description: This file defines Express.js routes related to project management, including CRUD operations, overview, usage, user-specific usage, and cost aggregation. It leverages models for Projects, Tenants, and SessionTracking, and integrates with analytics services for cost and session duration data.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing projects via CRUD controller

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for retrieving a project by ID via CRUD controller

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests for creating a new project via CRUD controller

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests for updating a project by ID via CRUD controller

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests for removing a project by ID via CRUD controller

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/overview')
methods.description: Provides a comprehensive overview of a project, including ownership, access, credits, usage, and user activity

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/usage')
methods.description: Returns total credits used and total costs for a project

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/users/usage')
methods.description: Provides per-user usage details, including costs and time spent

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/cost')
methods.description: Calculates total project cost from session tracking data
